batch_policy.model_rating_definition: 100 × product of leg model probabilities (naive joint proxy)
batch_policy.leg_strength_definition: 100 × geometric mean of leg model probabilities

notes: V6 qualifies on market edge, not probability alone.

Model fair odds never overwrite bookmaker odds.
